department: Department of Mathematical Sciences, Mellon College of Science

deadline.value: Application materials should be received by December 20 for full consideration.
deadline.quote: All application materials should be received by December 20 to be assured of full consideration.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged, so no waiver is needed.

gre_general.value: The department does not collect GRE General scores.
gre_general.quote: We do not collect scores for the GRE General Test.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is recommended but not required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is recommended but not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum is 86 out of 120; 100 is recommended.

english_waiver.value: Non-native speakers must submit a test even after a US university, with no exceptions.
english_waiver.quote: If you are a non-native English speaker, you need to meet this requirement even if you attended a university in the U.S. No exceptions will be made.

supervisor.value: Entering students are assigned an academic advisor; doctoral thesis advisors are selected after admission to candidacy.
supervisor.quote: A student entering the doctoral program will be assigned an academic advisor, who will assist the student in meeting the requirements for admission to candidacy. Once the student has found a thesis advisor, they will assume the role of the academic advisor.

funding.value: Nearly all full-time graduate students receive financial aid, such as assistantships or tuition scholarships.
funding.quote: Nearly all full-time graduate students in the Department receive some form of financial aid.

entry_route.value: Applicants must show competence equivalent to graduation from a recognized US four-year college.
entry_route.quote: To be admitted to this program applicants must document competence equivalent to graduation from a recognized U.S. four-year college, university or institute of technology.

notes: Language tests are required of all non-native speakers; the page lists DET 110/160 as a minimum.
